name: Chicken Fried Rice
instructions: Cook the rice and set it aside. Cut the chicken and carrot into small pieces. Cook the chicken in a pan until fully cooked. Add the carrot and cook until soft. Add the egg and stir. Add the rice and soy sauce. Mix everything together and serve.

name: Tomato Egg Stir Fry
instructions: Wash and cut the tomatoes into pieces. Beat the eggs in a bowl. Heat oil in a pan and cook the eggs. Remove the eggs and cook the tomatoes until soft. Add the eggs back to the pan. Season with salt and serve.

name: Garlic Butter Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta according to the package instructions. Melt butter in a pan and add chopped garlic. Cook until fragrant. Add the cooked pasta and mix well. Sprinkle cheese on top and serve.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
instructions: Cut the chicken and vegetables into small pieces. Put the chicken in a pot with water and bring to a boil. Add the carrot, potato, and onion. Simmer until the chicken is fully cooked and the vegetables are soft. Add salt and serve.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Beat the eggs in a bowl. Heat oil in a pan and scramble the eggs. Add cooked rice and stir well. Add soy sauce and chopped green onion. Cook for a few minutes and serve.

name: Tomato Pasta
instructions: Boil the pasta until tender. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook chopped garlic. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they form a sauce. Add the pasta and mix well. Serve warm.

name: Potato Omelette
instructions: Peel and slice the potato. Chop the onion. Cook the potato and onion in a pan until soft. Beat the eggs with salt and pour them into the pan. Cook until the eggs are set. Flip carefully and serve.

name: Chicken Salad
instructions: Cook the chicken thoroughly and let it cool. Wash and chop the lettuce, tomato, and cucumber. Cut the chicken into small pieces. Combine everything in a bowl and mix well.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Wash and cut the broccoli and carrot. Heat oil in a pan and add chopped garlic. Add the vegetables and stir fry until tender. Add soy sauce and mix well. Serve warm.

name: Cheese Omelette
instructions: Beat the eggs with milk. Melt butter in a pan. Pour in the egg mixture and cook over medium heat. Add cheese when the eggs begin to set. Fold the omelette and cook until the cheese melts.
